items.caption: Dense multi-unit fixture with dozens of locator and clamp units on a common base, plus a pneumatic valve panel driving the clamps.

items.title: EV underbody — BIW part data
items.caption: Stamped, flanged floor panels, longitudinal rails and cross-members with spot-weld seams. The structure carries body stiffness, battery-pack support and crash loads, and it is the geometry every locator and clamp is designed around.
